steps.say: For tenancies of two years or more, the agreement lets either side bring the tenancy to an end early. The tenant uses 3 months’ notice in writing, with different notice rules for landlord breaks.

From the start, the tenant cannot give notice in the first 3 months, so the earliest tenant end is after 6 months. The landlord has a one-off break at 6 months. Receiver and sale cases need at least 2 months’ notice, with sale needing 4 months from first notice. Overpaid rent needs repayment within 14 days after ending.
As background, the checklists invite both sides to note key dates to remember, such as the fixed-term end and notice dates, to manage these breaks.
